next_allowed_at.description: Earliest unix second at which the next creation passes the cadence rules.

recent.description: Unix seconds of recent creations (oldest first).

SeriesConfig.description: Contract-enforced creation cadence for a named series (e.g. "latent-benders", "marain-orbs"). Every field is optional; an unset field is not enforced.

max_mint_window_secs.description: If set, each collection must set mint_end_time (seconds after creation) and it must be at most this value.

max_per_window.description: At most this many collections per rolling `window_secs`.

min_interval_secs.description: Minimum seconds between two collections of this series.

operators.description: Who may create in this series besides the factory owner. Empty = anyone.
